items.quote: Thanksgiving is a federal holiday in the United States celebrated on the fourth Thursday of November
After 10 weeks at sea, Mayflower, with 102 passengers and a crew of about 30, reached what is today the United States
items.note: Same article: 'transported a group of English families, known today as the Pilgrims, from England to the New World in 1620.'

items.quote: Having brought in a good harvest, the Pilgrims celebrated at Plymouth for three days in the autumn of 1621.
acted as a middleman between them and Massasoit, the Wampanoag sachem
items.note: Some sources say Pokanoket (the Wampanoag band Massasoit led directly); a host may accept it, but Wampanoag is the standard answer.

items.quote: The NFL's Thanksgiving Day games have traditionally included one game hosted by the Detroit Lions since 1934
items.note: 'Nearly every year' is accurate: en:Detroit_Lions says 'Excluding the years of 1939-1944, due to World War II, the Lions have played on Thanksgiving ever since.' Dallas (since 1966) does not fit 'since 1934', so one answer. Minor: 'hosted a home game' is redundant; 'has played at home on Thanksgiving Day' reads cleaner.

items.quote: Thanksgiving or Thanksgiving Day, is an annual Canadian holiday held on the second Monday in October.
Hale famously campaigned for the creation of the American Thanksgiving holiday
items.note: Same article: 'She was the author of the nursery rhyme "Mary Had a Little Lamb".' (A rival claim by John Roulstone exists in older sources but Hale's authorship is the accepted answer.)

items.quote: The president of the United States is presented with a live domestic turkey by the National Turkey Federation (NTF)
items.note: Same article: 'The official presentation of a turkey to the president each year began in 1947 under President Harry S. Truman' and 'NTF began presenting the National Thanksgiving Turkey during the presidency of Harry Truman' (en:National_Turkey_Federation). Small caveat: 'The early years also included a joint presentation with the Poultry and Egg National Board', and the early birds were for eating, so 'live turkey every year since 1947' is slightly generous. Not enough to change the answer. Optional tightening: 'Since 1947, the president has been presented with a Thanksgiving turkey at the White House. Which industry group presents it?'
